evals.prompt: Agents keep opening PRs where typecheck fails, even though AGENTS.md tells them to run it. Make that stop. Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor all work in this repo.
evals.expected_output: A lefthook pre-commit and pre-push setup installed through prepare, one verify command named in AGENTS.md, a CI job repeating the hooks, each hook shown failing on a deliberate violation, and the required-check change written up for the user.
assertions: Installs git hooks that live in the repository rather than a tool-specific hook
Adds a prepare script so fresh clones and agent sandboxes get the hooks
Repeats the hooks in CI because hooks can be bypassed with --no-verify
Shows each hook failing on a deliberate violation before calling it installed
Replaces the prose instruction with one line naming the pre-PR command
Does not change branch protection itself; writes up the required-check change for the user

evals.prompt: turbo run test is green locally and in CI every time, but a teammate's fresh clone fails. What's going on?
evals.expected_output: The green runs are identified as cache hits, the suite is run cold in a fresh clone with --force, the import-time env singleton or missing env input in turbo.json is found, and an uncached run on main is proposed as a gate.
assertions: Distinguishes a cached check from a fresh test run in the diagnosis
Runs the suite in a fresh clone with the task-runner cache bypassed
Checks turbo.json env and globalEnv inputs against the variables the code reads
Looks for module state evaluated at import that the cached run never executed
Proposes an uncached run on main as a scheduled or required check

evals.prompt: Our answer-quality eval has been 100% green for a month. Can you check it's actually measuring something?
evals.expected_output: The scorer's code is read, it is found to check only length or to skip on failure, must-fail fixtures are added and shown to fail, and the report is changed to print passed, failed, skipped, and errored counts.
assertions: Reads the scorer's implementation rather than trusting its name
Checks the eval configuration for skip-on-failure modes and counts skipped or errored runs
Adds must-fail fixtures (off-topic but long, one factual error, empty) and shows each scores below the pass line
Makes the run fail when zero cases ran or skipped cases exceed the expected number

evals.prompt: The checkout e2e suite went green right after an agent's PR that 'fixed flakiness'. Is that real?
evals.expected_output: The diff and production code are searched for test-only headers, environment branches, and conditionals in tests; any bypass is reported with file and line; a lint rule or CI grep is proposed so the pattern fails next time.
assertions: Searches production code for branches keyed to test headers or test environments
Searches the test diff for conditionals, try/catch, retries, and skips
Sabotages the unit under test in a scratch branch to show whether the suite can fail
Proposes a gate that fails on the pattern rather than only a note

evals.prompt: Main broke twice yesterday with 30 agent PRs merged. Set up whatever we need so that doesn't happen again.
evals.expected_output: A PR size gate, a main-green required check with a fixes-main exception, the container build on the PR, WIP tied to review capacity, auto-approval limited to small low-risk paths, and a Risk and Proof section, with settings changes written up for the user.
assertions: Adds a check that blocks merging while main is red, with an exception for the fix PR
Adds a PR size gate excluding lockfiles and generated files, with a human-only exception label
Requires the container build on the PR
Explains the queueing knee and ties WIP to review capacity
Limits auto-approval to allow-listed low-risk paths under a small size limit
Adds the Risk and Proof section to the PR template
Leaves branch protection and required-check changes for the user to apply

baseline.model: claude-sonnet (fresh subagent contexts, no repository access)
baseline.without_skill: Diagnosed per-file boot correctly; proposed isolate: false globally with a caveat, node as default environment, transform cache, coverage off, sharding. Did not measure the ceiling, did not name the leaking calls, did not name task-runner contention.
baseline.with_skill: Read SKILL.md and levers.md. Measured ceiling first, second project isolated by vi.mock/fake timers/stubGlobal, node environment for DOM-free files, contention named, shard last. Passed assertions 1 to 3 and 5 to 6; assertion 4 needs a repository.
baseline.delta: Real and concentrated in observed-failure content (eligibility by leaking calls, ceiling measurement, contention). Baseline raised two levers the skill lacked: coverage on every run, node as the default environment; both added to levers.md.
